easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Extruder five times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
